g.title: crate Expose the Soft component catalog, its pages and embedded fonts.
crate::docs Route each catalog page to its interactive example gallery.
crate::docs::collections Demonstrate Soft layout, collection, table and chat components.
crate::docs::content Demonstrate Neutral typography and icon sizes and colors.
crate::docs::controls Demonstrate the action, feedback and choice recipes in the Soft catalog.
crate::docs::dates Demonstrate the Soft calendar and controlled date and time fields.
crate::docs::examples Assemble the catalog's component demonstrations.
crate::docs::feedback Demonstrate Soft badges, placeholders and status indicators.
crate::docs::forms Demonstrate standard form recipes through controlled public components.
crate::docs::navigation Demonstrate responsive navigation and application shells.
crate::docs::overlays Demonstrate the standard anchored layers, dialogs and notifications.
crate::docs::specimen Frame an interactive catalog specimen and show its source.
crate::docs::utilities Demonstrate scoped themes, localization and native link callbacks.
crate::fonts Supply offline Figtree font bytes for the catalog and its tests.
crate::look Style the Soft catalog shell from the active Neutral tokens.
crate::model Hold the catalog's selection, search and appearance signals.
crate::page Render a component's catalog heading and documentation content.
crate::pages Register the Astryx component catalog pages in docsite category order.
crate::shell Mount the Soft catalog with searchable navigation and a theme toggle.
